what3words

  • CURIE: gmeow:what3words
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/what3words
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

A what3words address — three words that identify a 3m×3m square on Earth (e.g. 'filled.county.limes').

Structure

Property shape: datatype property; gmeow:Geocode -> xsd:string; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:what3words from gmeow:Geocode to xsd:string when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Geocode

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use for a what3words three-word address on a Geocode.

Avoid when

  • Avoid mixing it with another system on the same Geocode.

How to use

  • Set gmeow:what3words on a Geocode whose gmeow:geocodeFrame is gmeow:referenceFrameWhat3Words.

Examples

  • ex:w3wLoc gmeow:what3words "filled.county.limes".
